<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="סיון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918708_theRebbe_155" batchId="meluket-_D7_A1_D7_99_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918708_theRebbe_155__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the Omer offering and its waving relate to the heart's desire, through which God's will is drawn down, achieving true completeness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is what is said, "And you shall count for yourselves... from the day you bring the Omer of the waving..."</t>
    <t s="1">For the matter of the Omer of the waving etc. is as stated,</t>
    <t s="2">"And he shall wave the Omer... for your acceptance,"</t>
    <t s="3">"For your acceptance" is the desire of the heart,</t>
    <t s="4">And through this desire</t>
    <t s="5">(of the person)</t>
    <t s="6">they make and draw down the will of the Omnipresent.</t>
    <t s="7">And this is: When are they complete? At the time when Israel does the will of the Omnipresent,</t>
    <t s="8">For this drawing down is the matter of completeness,</t>
    <t s="9">the true perfection.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
